verses.text: "Now, son of man, take a clay brick, put it in front of you, and draw a picture of a city on it, the city of Jerusalem.
Then act out an attack on it. Build siege walls against it and a ramp up to it. Set up army camps around it and put battering rams all around it.

Then take an iron pan and set it up like an iron wall between you and the city. Turn your face toward it. It will be under siege, and you will be the one attacking it. This will be a sign for the people of Israel.
Then lie down on your left side and put the guilt of the people of Israel on yourself. You will carry their guilt for the number of days you lie on your side.
I have given you the same number of days as the years of their sin: three hundred ninety days. That is how long you will carry the guilt of the people of Israel.
When you have finished this, lie down again, this time on your right side, and carry the guilt of the people of Judah. I have given you forty days, one day for each year.
Turn your face toward the siege of Jerusalem. With your arm bared, prophesy against the city.
Look, I will tie you up with ropes so that you cannot turn from one side to the other until you have finished the days of your siege.
Take wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt. Put them in one container and make bread out of them for yourself. You are to eat it during the three hundred ninety days you lie on your side.
Weigh out twenty shekels of food to eat each day, about eight ounces, and eat it at set times.
Measure out a sixth of a hin of water, about two-thirds of a quart, and drink it at set times.
Eat the food as you would a barley cake. Bake it in front of the people, using human dung for fuel."
The LORD said, "This is how the people of Israel will eat unclean food among the nations where I will drive them."

Then I said, "Oh, Lord GOD! I have never made myself unclean. From my youth until now I have never eaten anything that died on its own or was torn apart by wild animals. No unclean meat has ever entered my mouth."
He said, "All right. I will let you use cow dung instead of human dung to bake your bread."

Then he said to me, "Son of man, I am going to cut off the food supply in Jerusalem. The people will weigh out their food and eat it with worry. They will measure out their water and drink it in despair.
They will run short of food and water. They will look at each other in shock and waste away because of their sin."
